comments.body:
Have you configured the battery parameters correctly?
https://docs.px4.io/master/en/advanced_config/parameter_reference.html#battery-calibration

> Have you configured the battery parameters correctly? https://docs.px4.io/master/en/advanced_config/parameter_reference.html#battery-calibration

Yes. In QGroundControl shows correctly. Actually my code of above - onPassthruIncomingMessageAsync() is comes from QGroundControl's.
So the implemenation in MAVSDK is not correct? If so, can you suggest what is wrong, or make a pull request? Sorry, I don't have time to look into this in detail right now.

I have implemented the fix as suggested by @imindude, and can confirm it works.  Battery voltage is now reporting correctly. p.s. I did a [git pull origin main] and recompiled.  I noticed the code is not in the release (v.0.47.0) that I got.

My other Raspberry Pi pulled v0.48.0, (no, I have no clue why, but I surely do not have the guts to update the file with these skills) and the code was not in there either.   Anyway, thank you for the fix.
@imindude would you mind opening a PR with your proposed changes to MAVSDK? :blush:
